name: STIHL MS 212 C-BE
blurb: 38.6 cc. STIHL lists an 18″ bar and 3/8″ PICCO PM3 chain. PM3 at 3/8″ PICCO is .050″ in this catalog. The drive-link count is not in the chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 212 C-BE is a 38.6 cc gas saw. STIHL's specification table (catalog p. 64, specifications as of 1 October 2024) lists an 18″ bar and 3/8″ PICCO PM3 chain. The saw-chain chart lists PM3 at .050″ for 3/8″ PICCO (code 3636) and at .043″ for 1/4″ PICCO (code 3670). The specification table's pitch is 3/8″ PICCO, so the gauge is the .050″ PM3 row (code 3636), not the .043″ 1/4″ PM3 row. STIHL's drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167) does not name this model, so this page does not print a drive-link count. Count the drive links on the bar stamp before you order. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
notice: No drive-link count is published for the MS 212 C-BE in this catalog. Use the bar stamp.

bars.note: Specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024): 18″ bar, 3/8″ PICCO, chain type PM3, 38.6 cc. The chain-type chart lists 3/8″ PICCO PM3 at .050″ (code 3636). No drive-link count is printed for the MS 212 C-BE. STIHL's file table lists 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024) and PM3 chain-type row (3/8″ PICCO at .050″, code 3636), read 7 Nov 2026. The drive-link chart on catalog pp. 166–167 does not name the MS 212 C-BE.
